title: Small stratified products and their unit-component embeddings for supplied module families
statement: Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$ and scheme bounds [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $X$ be a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth]. Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with $A=\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and coefficient sheaves $R_T=p_T^*\underline A$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, def-sfb-integral-model-condensed-coefficients]. Use the module categories, pullbacks, pushforwards and specified adjunction units $\eta_a$ of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. For every bounded scheme $T$ admitting a locally closed immersion into $X$, suppose given a set $I_T\in\mathcal V$ and a family of $R_T$-modules $(F_{T,t})_{t\in I_T}$; their sections are in $\mathcal V$. No local-model or constructibility condition is imposed on these supplied modules. Let $H$ be all finite locally closed scheme stratifications $h=(a_s:S_s\hookrightarrow X)_{s<n(h)}$ in the fixed bound [def-constructible-stratification]. Then $H$ and $J=\coprod_{h\in H}\prod_{s<n(h)}I_{S_s}$ belong to $\mathcal V$. For every $j=(h,(t_s)_s)\in J$, the product $P_j=\prod_{s<n(h)}a_{s*}F_{S_s,t_s}$ exists. Through the internal-to-sectionwise equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], its sections are $P_j(V)=\prod_s(a_{s*}F_{S_s,t_s})(V)\in\mathcal V$, and its empty product is the zero module sheaf. For every $R_X$-module $M$, every $j=(h,(t_s)_s)$ and every tuple of isomorphisms $\varphi_s:a_s^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{S_s,t_s}$, the map $u:M\to P_j$ with components $a_{s*}(\varphi_s)\circ\eta_{a_s,M}$ is a monomorphism. Equivalently, any $M$ whose restrictions on some finite stratification are represented by the supplied families admits such a $j$, tuple of isomorphisms and monomorphism. This assertion includes empty strata and, when $X$ is empty, the empty stratification.

proof.text: In the fixed scheme bound [def-weil-size-convention], the scheme codes and their morphism codes are sets in $\mathcal V$. For each $n\in\mathbf N$, encode a candidate stratification by an $n$-tuple of bounded schemes and $n$ morphisms to $X$. The immersion, disjoint-image and covering conditions of [def-constructible-stratification] cut out a subset of these codes. The union of these subsets over $n$ is $H\in\mathcal V$. For each $h$, the finite dependent product $\prod_{s<n(h)}I_{S_s}$ is in $\mathcal V$ by closure of a Grothendieck universe under indexed products; its dependent sum over $H$ is $J\in\mathcal V$. These are actual bounded codes, not isomorphism classes; distinct codes cause no problem.

proof.text: Fix a labelled stratification j and take the existing categorical product of its factors stratifiedModelFactors. The category of internal modules is abelian, hence has finite products. The equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] preserves this product, and evaluation on every V preserves it by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-limits-sectionwise]. Compose evaluation with the module forgetful functor to Type. Its mapped fan is limiting, hence is uniquely isomorphic to the ordinary dependent product of the underlying section types. The projection equations identify the isomorphism with the displayed section comparison, proving its bijectivity. Every section type is in universe u+1.

The existing module-pullback interface [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] provides additivity and preservation of finite limits. To check joint zero detection, first observe that quasi-compact locally Noetherian X is Noetherian. Each immersion domain has Noetherian underlying space via its topological embedding, so its immersion into X is quasi-compact. The stratification covering equation says that these finitely many immersions jointly cover X. For an internal module N whose pullbacks vanish, use the existing upperStarObjXIso comparison to conclude that all corresponding pullbacks of its underlying abelian sheaf vanish. Apply [lem-pod-finite-qc-proetale-abelian-detection] to the identity of this abelian sheaf; each pulled-back identity is zero since its object is zero. Its identity is therefore zero. Faithfulness of Mod.forget identifies the identity and zero of N, proving that N is zero. This applies to arbitrary modules and to the empty family.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-joint-adjunction-model-embedding] with the module pullbacks, direct images, and precisely the supplied upperStarLowerStarAdjunction of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. The previous step checks joint zero detection, and the existing pullback instances check additivity and kernel preservation. Use the given models and isomorphisms phi. The theorem proves that Pi.lift of the required components is monic. The ordinary Pi.lift projection equations give exactly unit.app M followed by lowerStar.map (phi s).hom for the chosen categorical product cone.

proof.text: If the restrictions of $M$ on some $h$ are represented by the supplied families, choose for each of its finitely many positions a label $t_s$ and an isomorphism $\varphi_s$. This defines $j\in J$, and step 4 supplies the map. Conversely, such a tuple of isomorphisms is exactly a witness that the restrictions are represented. Empty label sets simply remove the corresponding labelled stratifications from $J$; there is no unconditional assertion that $J$ is nonempty.

proof.text: If n=0, Fin n is empty. Product extensionality proves that the identity and zero on the chosen product agree, because there are no projections to check. Thus its point is a zero object. The same finite quasi-compact detection theorem [lem-pod-finite-qc-proetale-abelian-detection] already permits an empty family when X is empty, so the proof of monicity remains valid. Empty strata are allowed throughout: the embedding and Noetherian-domain arguments apply unchanged, and the stratification covering equation supplies all required surjectivity.

lean.statement: theorem noetherian_stratified_model_product_embedding (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X] (I : LocallyClosedModelDomain X → Type (u + 1)) (F : ∀ T : LocallyClosedModelDomain X, I T → integralStratifiedModelModules l E T.val) : ∀ j : StratifiedModelIndex X I, ∃ c : Fan (stratifiedModelFactors l E X I F j), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ (∀ V : X.ProEt, Function.Bijective (fun x : (integralStratifiedModelSections l E X V).obj c.pt ↦ fun s : Fin j.1.n ↦ (integralStratifiedModelSections l E X V).map (c.π.app ⟨s⟩) x)) ∧ (j.1.n = 0 → IsZero c.pt) ∧ (∀ (M : integralStratifiedModelModules l E X) (φ : ∀ s : Fin j.1.n, (CondensedRing.upperStar (integralModelCondensedCoefficients l E).X (j.1.immersion s)).obj M ≅ F (stratificationModelDomain j.1 s) (j.2 s)), ∃ f : M ⟶ c.pt, Mono f ∧ ∀ s : Fin j.1.n, f ≫ c.π.app ⟨s⟩ = (CondensedRing.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (integralModelCondensedCoefficients l E).X (j.1.immersion s)).unit.app M ≫ (CondensedRing.lowerStar (integralModelCondensedCoefficients l E).X (j.1.immersion s)).map (φ s).hom)
lean.note: H is the recorded finite locally closed stratification type in Type (u + 1), and J is the displayed dependent sum StratifiedModelIndex in the same universe.
